idpGroups.heading: Single sign-on groups
idpGroups.description: Members of these identity-provider groups get the role at their next single sign-on. The highest role wins. Members you add or re-role by hand are never changed by a group.

workflow.heading: Workflow
workflow.description: How items move from annotation to done. Changes apply to the next submit or review; items already in review keep their tasks.

reviewOptions.sampled: Sampled — a share of submissions is reviewed

workflow.sampleRateHint: The same items are picked every time; an item that was ever rejected is always reviewed again.
workflow.allowSkip: Annotators may skip items (with a reason)
workflow.allowSelfReview: Reviewers may review their own submissions
workflow.consensusHint: More than 1: each item is annotated independently by that many people, then a reviewer fuses or picks their versions. Needs review. Applies to items whose first task opens after saving.
workflow.goldOff: Off — open gold tasks by hand
workflow.goldHint: Mixes gold items (approved items marked as references) into each annotator's queue to score their accuracy.

members.heading: Members
members.emptyMessage: This project has no members yet.
members.ssoGroupTitle: Granted by a single sign-on group; changing the role makes it manual

page.title: {{name}} settings
page.readOnlyNotice: You are not an owner of this project — settings are read-only.
page.cacheConnectorHint: Thumbnails and image tiles. Changing it regenerates them.
page.extractPdfTextForce: Also redo PDFs nobody has annotated
page.companionHint: A file with one of these extensions beside an item of the same name (photo.txt beside photo.jpg) is shown with it as context instead of becoming an item. Applies from the next scan.
page.pdfModeLayout: Layout: annotate on the page (boxes, entity spans)
page.pdfModeText: Text: extract the text once, annotate it as text
page.pdfModeHint: Text mode extracts each PDF's text (scanned pages through the organisation's OCR model) and stores it on the result connector, so it needs one. Applies to PDFs the next scan finds; existing items keep their mode.
page.confirmDeletePrompt: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
